programs.title: Romance to the Rescue
programs.desc: Kyra plans to enter her dog in an agility show to impress a potential love interest. The problem is, she doesn't have a dog, so she needs to find and train one quickly.

programs.title: A Taste of Summer
programs.desc: A woman moves to Bright Shore, where she opens a restaurant and rediscovers her passion. Upon arrival, she encounters a former baseball player who has a competitive streak and owns his own restaurant.

programs.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Truth Be Told
programs.desc: The Postables (Eric Mabius, Kristin Booth, Crystal Lowe) embark on a mission to deliver a soldier's letter from Afghanistan to a bullied teen, while Oliver's estranged father surprises him with news that shakes him to the core.

programs.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: The Impossible Dream
programs.desc: The Postables (Eric Mabius, Kristin Booth) race against time to reunite a soldier in Afghanistan with her family.

programs.title: Duke
programs.desc: Marine Sergeant Terry Pulaski returns from fighting in Afghanistan with scars that are both mental and physical. Feeling like a burden to his family, Terry takes off with his Border collie, Duke, to begin a life on the streets. But years later, when his faithful pet falls ill, he's forced to reach out for help and also bring himself to reconnect with the daughter he has long since left behind.

programs.title: Love Under the Rainbow
programs.desc: A grade school teacher unwillingly finds herself falling for a widowed architect whose daughter is a new student in her class.
